svg.title: Which run gets which role
svg.desc: Matrix of nine GitHub Actions runs against the example plan and apply roles, marking each claim value that fails an apply condition; only a push or workflow_dispatch on main, in production, from apply.yml gets the apply role.
svg.text: A run needs all four claims to get TerraformApply
Subject octo-org/infra. workflow_ref is shown without octo-org/infra/.github/workflows/.
